stem.text: A car is stationary at traffic lights. When the traffic lights change to green, the driver presses down sharply on the accelerator. The resultant horizontal force acting on the car varies with time as shown.

stem.alt: Graph of force against time with a vertical axis labelled force and a horizontal axis labelled time, showing a horizontal line at zero that steps up to a higher constant level partway along the time axis.

stem.text: Which graph shows the variation with time of the speed of the car?

A.alt: Graph of speed against time, with axes labelled speed and time, showing a line that starts at zero and rises after a delay.

B.alt: Graph of speed against time, with axes labelled speed and time, showing a curve that starts at zero and rises after a delay.

C.alt: Graph of speed against time, with axes labelled speed and time, showing a curve that rises and then levels off at a constant value.

D.alt: Graph of speed against time, with axes labelled speed and time, showing an S-shaped curve that rises from zero and then levels off at a constant value.
